label: Phenomenal occurrence among supplied episodes
definition: An episode contributes a phenomenal occurrence exactly when it both occurs and is classified by the supplied Experienced predicate. AssertionRealizationsExperienced supplies that classification for occurring thought episodes realizing assertions of the selected content.
note: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. Experienced is primitive here and is intended to mark what is experienced phenomenally. Thought, behavioral discrimination, verbal report, and actual existence of a representative are separate. How to recognize this property independently remains open.
